derived_from: actual persisted frozen pilot Parquet files, not documentation alone

hrrr_rh.note: concatenated into the in-memory HRRR dataframe by data/pilot_loader.py:_load_hrrr_with_rh() -- RH is now just another native HRRR variable to every downstream function

ecmwf_deterministic.not_present_reason: target-day-only production run never reaches forecast_hour>144 where these fields replace mx2t3/mn2t3 -- validated separately in the small-sample phase, documented, not a defect

pipeline_survival_gap.summary_before_fix: Only instantaneous temperature was threaded through from each numerical source into the integrated dataset's model-accessible outputs (structured_features.parquet, forecast_trajectories.parquet, human_readable_states.csv). Dewpoint, wind, pressure, cloud cover, precipitation, solar radiation, and native period Tmax/Tmin were all correctly extracted and present in canonical frozen data for every numerical source (and loaded into memory by data/pilot_loader.py), but were not surfaced by any integration-layer output. GEFS member-level trajectories (vs. per-member daily-max scalars) had the same gap.
pipeline_survival_gap.resolution: Two new, additive output tables now carry every non-temperature variable family through to the integrated dataset, without touching or risking the existing (protected) temperature-only pipeline: atmospheric_trajectories.parquet (HRRR/GFS/NBM/ECMWF deterministic, all non-temperature variables, normalized long format, run selection reused unchanged from the existing latest_usable_run, no-lookahead re-verified per row via eligible_mask()) and gefs_member_trajectories.parquet (GEFS, ALL variables including TMP, at full per-member granularity for all 31 members -- mean/median/std/quantiles/disagreement/revision are all derivable downstream without re-downloading). forecast_trajectories.parquet, structured_features.parquet, state_index.parquet, gefs_members.parquet, and human_readable_states.csv/.parquet are byte-for-byte unchanged in row/column count after the fix (26542 / 123-cols-480-rows / 480 / 14880 / 31-cols-480-rows respectively, verified identical to the pre-fix manifest) -- confirming the fix is purely additive.
pipeline_survival_gap.hrrr_rh_backfill: RH was not natively extracted by the original HRRR pilot (a deliberate source-identity-preservation choice, not a technical barrier -- see docs/variable_semantics.md). A dedicated, pilot-scope-only backfill (scripts/pilot_phase3c_hrrr_rh.py) added it via the exact same find_message()/Checkpoint/run_concurrent methodology as the original HRRR pilot, in its own directory (data/processed/pilot/hrrr_rh/), confirmed unambiguously selectable (no duplicate-candidate resolution needed) via live probing before extraction. Result: 20836/20836 work items DONE, 0 FAILED, values in [15.2, 100.0]%, units '%'.

gefs: member_level_trajectory (all 31 members, all variables including TMP)

still_not_extracted.reason: structurally absent from this pilot's forecast_hour range (0-39); not a pipeline defect -- see the 'not_present_reason' field under sources.ecmwf_deterministic above

decision_gate_reason: The pipeline-survival gap identified on 2026-09-29 is closed: every useful non-temperature variable (dewpoint, wind, pressure, cloud, precipitation, radiation, native period Tmax/Tmin) that is correctly extracted and frozen in canonical data is now model-accessible via atmospheric_trajectories.parquet / gefs_member_trajectories.parquet, without flattening semantics or duplicating the protected instantaneous-temperature pipeline. No source methodology, extraction schedule, or existing scalar feature was changed to achieve this.
